```{r}
mods <- read_rds(nested_here("data", "models", "final_mods.rds"))
```

cbind(asthma_count_yes, asthma_count_no) ~ 
    poly(num_time, 2) + student_race + student_gender + region_3grp + 
        grade_level + wave + poly(active_months, 2) + any_events_cumulative
        
```{r}
summary(mods$asthma)
```

```{r}
broom::tidy(mods$asthma)
```

```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(
  mods$asthma,
  pairwise ~ wave | data_schoolyear, 
  type = "response"
  )

emmeans::emmeans(
  mods$asthma,
  ~ data_schoolyear | wave, 
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  ) |> 
  emmeans::contrast("consec", infer = TRUE) |>
  rbind() |> 
  emmeans::contrast("trt.vs.ctrl", by = "contrast")
  # data.frame() #|> 
  ggplot(aes(data_schoolyear, odds.ratio, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = wave)) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ wave)
  
  
```

```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(
  mods$asthma,
  pairwise ~ any_events_cumulative, 
  type = "response"
  ) 
```
